666:     kwargs_to_start_span, other_tags_for_span, start_time_ns, finish_time_ns
667: ):
668:     """Insert the authorizer span.
669:         Without this:        parent span --child-> inferred span
670:         With this insertion: parent span --child-> upstreamAuthorizerSpan --child-> inferred span
671: 
672:     Args:
673:         kwargs_to_start_span (Dict): the same keyword arguments used for the inferred span
674:         other_tags_for_span (Dict): the same tag keyword arguments used for the inferred span
675:         start_time_ns (int): the start time of the span in nanoseconds
676:         finish_time_ns (int): the finish time of the sapn in nanoseconds
677:     """
678:     trace_ctx = tracer.current_trace_context()
679:     upstream_authorizer_span = tracer.trace(
680:         "aws.apigateway.authorizer", **kwargs_to_start_span
681:     )
682:     upstream_authorizer_span.set_tags(other_tags_for_span)
683:     upstream_authorizer_span.set_tag("operation_name", "aws.apigateway.authorizer")
684:     # always sync for the authorizer invocation
685:     InferredSpanInfo.set_tags_to_span(upstream_authorizer_span, synchronicity="sync")
686:     upstream_authorizer_span.start_ns = int(start_time_ns)
687:     upstream_authorizer_span.finish(finish_time_ns / 1e9)
688:     # trace context needs to be set again as it is reset by finish()
689:     tracer.context_provider.activate(trace_ctx)
690:     return upstream_authorizer_span
